summary: The Saudi-backed Yemeni government launched a military operation to retake Houthi-held territories, while Israeli forces eliminated three Hamas operatives in Khan Younis, including a Nukhba terrorist linked to the October 7 attack. In Lebanon, an IDF soldier was seriously wounded in an operational accident, and artillery shelling hit Kfar Tabnit. Iran reported air defense activity over Mahabad and intense UAV flights in West Azerbaijan, alongside diplomatic overtures to Gulf states.
key_points: Yemen's Saudi-backed government announced a military offensive against Houthi forces to regain control of all Yemeni territory. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94476)

IDF strikes in Khan Younis killed Hamas military commander Muad Gamal Abu Nuseira and surveillance commander Mahmoud Ibrahim Dib Alyan, both accused of violating ceasefire. (Source: @New_security8200/204094)
IDF eliminated Nukhba terrorist Zakar Nabil Musa Qaisi in Khan Younis; he infiltrated Israel on October 7 and managed a Turkish charity used to fund Hamas. (Source: @idf_telegram/25275)
Artillery shelling and gunfire from Israeli vehicles reported east of Jabalia and Beit Lahia in northern Gaza. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/397113)
An IDF soldier was severely wounded and an officer moderately injured by an accidental grenade explosion during operations in southern Lebanon. (Source: @New_security8200/204086)
Iranian air defense activated over Mahabad, West Azerbaijan; intense UAV activity detected over Urmia, Piranshahr, and Oshnavieh. (Source: @shin_persian/10737, @shin_persian/10732)
Iran's foreign minister said Gulf states are cooperating on a new path for regional trust, peace, and security in the Persian Gulf. (Source: @VahidOnline/78621)
UKMTO reported an incident in the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait, 60 nautical miles south of Al Mukha, Yemen. (Source: @presstv/209484)

sections.executive_summary: The Saudi-backed Yemeni government launched a military operation to retake Houthi-held territories, marking a significant escalation in the Yemen conflict. Israeli forces conducted targeted killings of three Hamas operatives in Khan Younis, including a commander involved in the October 7 attack. Simultaneously, Iran signaled diplomatic engagement with Gulf states while its air defenses activated in northwestern Iran.

points: Iranian air defense systems engaged over Mahabad in West Azerbaijan Province, indicating heightened alert status in the northwest. (Source: @shin_persian/10737)

Intense UAV activity was recorded over West Azerbaijan cities including Urmia, Piranshahr, and Oshnavieh, suggesting increased surveillance or operational tempo near the Turkish and Iraqi borders. (Source: @shin_persian/10732)

IRGC General Ali Fadavi stated no U.S. or allied naval vessels remain in the Persian Gulf or northern Indian Ocean for the first time since 1853, claiming a strategic shift. (Source: @SharghDaily/187533)

Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi described recent regional diplomacy as 'very effective, respectful, and friendly,' asserting Gulf states are jointly pursuing a new framework for Persian Gulf security. (Source: @VahidOnline/78621)
IRGC advisor Ali Fadavi warned nuclear weapons use would not provide the U.S. an exit from conflict and would inflict severe damage on American interests. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/397110)
Explosions were reported in the Strait of Hormuz attributed to Iranian fire targeting ships allegedly violating an Iranian blockade. (Source: @N12chat/228384)
Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary acknowledged the rapidly deteriorating economy has created one of the most difficult periods in the country's history. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94485)
An Arab resident of East Jerusalem drove into and killed a woman in Jerusalem's Rehavia neighborhood, fled the scene, and was arrested by Jerusalem District Police. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94473)
UAE authorities allege a co-pilot planned to hijack a passenger aircraft and crash it in Israel; the suspect faces a potential death penalty as the investigation continues. (Source: @pkpoi/144169)

IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir warned that recruitment shortfalls threaten strategic depth, urging expanded enlistment targets and designating 2027 for comprehensive war review. (Source: @yediotnews25/135749)
The UK Green Party passed a resolution declaring 'Zionism is racism' by a 56% majority; Israel's Foreign Ministry condemned the party as a 'terror-supporting body.' (Source: @lelotsenzura/94480)
IDF airstrike in Khan Younis eliminated Hamas military wing commander Muad Gamal Abu Nuseira; the military said the strike aimed to remove an immediate threat. (Source: @New_security8200/204094)

A separate IDF strike killed Hamas surveillance commander Mahmoud Ibrahim Dib Alyan, who was advancing terror plans against Israeli forces along the Gaza border 'yellow line' and violating the ceasefire. (Source: @New_security8200/204094)

IDF targeted Nukhba terrorist Zakar Nabil Musa Qaisi in Khan Younis; he participated in the October 7 infiltration and managed the Turkish charity Deniz Feneri, which allegedly funneled funds to Hamas. (Source: @idf_telegram/25275)
Artillery shelling and gunfire from Israeli armored vehicles were reported east of Jabalia and the Beit Lahia project in northern Gaza. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/397113)

An IDF soldier was severely wounded and an officer moderately injured by an accidental grenade explosion during operational activity in southern Lebanon on Friday; the incident is under investigation. (Source: @New_security8200/204086)
Artillery shelling was reported in the area of Kfar Tabnit in southern Lebanon, with live map updates indicating ongoing fire. (Source: @redlinkleb/46583, @redlinkleb/46584)

Intense Iranian UAV activity over West Azerbaijan Province (bordering Iraq and Turkey) suggests heightened aerial operations near the Syrian and Iraqi frontiers, though no direct strikes in Syria or Iraq were reported. (Source: @shin_persian/10732)
UAE authorities are investigating a co-pilot accused of planning to hijack a plane and crash it in Israel, with a possible death penalty upon conviction. (Source: @pkpoi/144169)

Iran's foreign minister stated Gulf states are actively participating in a new Iranian-led initiative for Persian Gulf peace, stability, and security based on mutual trust. (Source: @VahidOnline/78621)
All U.S. B-1 bombers have departed RAF Fairford in the UK and returned to continental U.S. bases, per Pentagon confirmation citing operational security. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/397101)
